sheets.subject: vela (top-left reference portrait)
sheets.prompt: Create an original transparent dialogue expression atlas for Vela, the dark-haired woman in the TOP LEFT cell of the supplied Poem portrait sheet. Use that one cell for character identity and painting style only. Ignore all other characters. Preserve warm brown skin, blue-green eyes, long midnight-blue side braid with gold ties, gold earrings with teal drops, embroidered turquoise mantle, ivory shirt, and circular gold lighthouse clasp with rope, together with the same three-quarter view facing viewer’s right. Output a wide canvas with exactly three equal square cells in one horizontal row. Each cell contains a complete isolated chest-up portrait with matching scale, silhouette, costume, hairstyle, body pose, head position and torso crop. Place the entire figure inside each cell with a generous truly transparent gutter on all four sides, including space below the aligned straight bottom crop. Change facial expression only: LEFT clear determination with steady eyes and a firm mouth, CENTER anxious concern with higher inner brows and a slightly parted mouth, RIGHT warm confident relief with a restrained closed-mouth smile. Match the clean illustrated fantasy linework and painted color of the source. The figure is opaque and every pixel outside the silhouette is truly transparent. No added props, text, labels, frames, backdrop, halo or outside shadows. This is original artwork for Poem. The three portraits must swap smoothly in a conversation.
